subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins

question: Should this PR be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106189, including the policy that every non-E404 pre-install npm metadata failure preserves existing plugin state?
rationale: Two viable branches implement the same lifecycle behavior, while this PR additionally fixes the sibling update-check parser; selecting the permanent branch and accepting the broader upgrade compatibility policy requires plugin-update owner intent.

options.title: Land this complete branch
options.body: Refresh this PR on current main and use it as the canonical fix because it covers both state preservation and the sibling npm 12 parser.

options.title: Land the narrower competitor
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 for state preservation and separately track the update-check parser normalization.

recommendation.title: Land this complete branch
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR on current main and use it as the canonical fix because it covers both state preservation and the sibling npm 12 parser.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected update lifecycle and sibling parser both trace to this contributor's feature history.
